g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in and the offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning mode answers today). Declining leaves home unchanged ('Not now'), and the card is hidden or retried if the ad fails to load or verify.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning answers until midnight, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after a 3+ day gap for a non-subscriber, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal adds no cap or lock ('removes nothing free: yes'); it only adds a sample of a paid feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card is a dismissible list card on the Chats home (s01), which is rated safe. It is not inside the conversation and not over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Advanced reasoning mode is a paywall bullet (l02, s02.e03), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The offer copy says 'All your past chats will be lost in 30 days if you do not upgrade to Luzia+'. This is a claim about current app behavior, and no element or mechanic in the model supports it. The model also says no free-tier limit was observed.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The subscribers field says Luzia+ members never see the card, and the reward is something their plan already includes, so payers are spared.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 3 answers that expire at midnight local time, a sample that ends. It does not give away the plan's main benefit and takes nothing from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears on the home screen at app open, before the user has started any task, and it is dismissible.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn sponsored game, and the reward is granted only once the play is confirmed ('That game didn't count' otherwise). The trigger, a 3+ day gap before the first open, is something the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the Luzia+ paywall feature 'Advanced reasoning mode', the Luzia+ badge on Chats home, and the 'How can I help you today?' prompt card.

other_concern: The invented 30-day chat-loss threat is also a deceptive pressure tactic and would be a risk even if it were supported. It should be removed from the copy.
